publication_schema_note: Curated public results format version 2. Distinct from runner report schema_version 3 and analysis_protocol_version 2.

provenance.binary_source_note: Release inferedge-bench-scheduler was built from c35381c. Collector and analyzer Python tooling for this campaign came from 0b2b65d.
provenance.benchmark_binary_sha256_note: Historical provenance hash for the measured executable. A rebuilt binary may have a different SHA-256.

adaptive_internal_policy.note: C++ adaptive early-seal minimum target constant. Not one of the five recorded cell-definition identity keys and not a CLI flag.

experimental_design.rotation_balance_note: Perfect three-position balance is impossible with 20 blocks; recorded position counts are disclosed and are not claimed to be perfectly balanced.

arrival_policy.arrival_screen_note: Coarse inclusive maximum generator-lag screen only; not precise arrival-fidelity certification.

primary_statistics.endpoint_note: Producer-observed P50 successful end-to-end latency (submit start until the future is observed ready). Includes completion-observation effects; not pure inference latency.

exploratory_statistics.note: Exploratory contrast only. Do not treat as a co-primary hypothesis and do not claim that G3 beats A.

batch_formation_summary.mean_realized_batch_size_definition: sum(size * count) / sum(count) over sealed-batch histogram bins with size >= 1; weighted request sum matches requests_entered_engine_runs; sealed count matches engine_run_count.
batch_formation_summary.G3_counted_histogram_note: Every counted G3 trial sealed exactly 500 size-2 batches (nonzero histogram {2: 500}). Individual early-seal events are not inferred.
batch_formation_summary.histogram_inference_note: Sealed-batch histograms do not identify individual adaptive early-seal events.

secondary_descriptive_metrics.throughput_denominator_note: Paired analyzer successful_throughput uses successes per TOTAL trial second. Arrival-window throughput is reported separately and must not be mixed.

engine_run_aggregates.note: Aggregate engine-run duration is descriptive and is not pure inference latency or isolated queue wait.

generator_lag.note: Descriptive generator lateness summaries; arrival fidelity remains not_certified.

limitations: Arrival fidelity was not certified; phase_boundary_fidelity remains unavailable.
The 5,000,000 nanosecond maximum generator-lag screen is a coarse lateness bound, not precise scheduling certification.
Producer-observed latency includes completion-observation delay and is not pure model inference latency.
Queue waiting was not separately instrumented.
The study used one Apple Silicon host.
The model was CPU GEMM (gemm_f32), not a production LLM.
Only the frozen 1000 RPS A/G2/G3 adaptive contrast was evaluated in this three-arm study.
This was not a saturated-throughput study.
Results should not be generalized to all workloads, hosts, or saturation regimes.
No universal adaptive-batching superiority is claimed.
No automatic winner or superiority declaration is made.
Exploratory G3-minus-A is not a co-primary hypothesis and does not support a claim that G3 beats A.
Raw trial stdout/stderr and full environment dumps are not part of this curated public extract.
Bit-identical timing is not promised across hosts or rebuilt binaries.

allowed_statements: Under the tested conditions, G3 formed mean size-two sealed batches.
Under the tested conditions, G2 formed multi-request batches with mean realized batch size approximately 2.967.
Under the tested conditions, producer-observed P50 was lower for G3 than G2 by the reported primary paired effect.
The paired 95% confidence interval for the primary P50 effect excludes zero.
Under the tested conditions, exploratory producer-observed P50 for G3 remained above A.
Successful throughput under this fixed offered rate was similar across arms when measured per total-trial second.
